data.current_description: A tool call is JSON and has no room for a video, so a file on your machine comes in here as multipart form-data: up to 5 files per request, 100 MB each. The answer lists each file's id, which his tools take wherever a stored file is expected. A file is kept for 30 days, a year once shared, or for good with `keep`. One that could not be stored is listed in `refused` with the reason, and the others still go through. Takes an API key or a sign-in token. Limit: 60 requests per minute per key, shared with the MCP endpoint.
data.summary_suggestion: Upload files for Cedric's tools to use
data.description_suggestion: Uploads local files (up to 5 per request, 100 MB each) as multipart form-data for use by Cedric's connected tools. Returns file IDs for each successfully stored file and lists any rejected files with reasons. Files are retained for 30 days by default, 1 year if shared, or indefinitely with the `keep` parameter. Partial failures are allowed—rejected files don't prevent other uploads from completing. Requires API key or sign-in token. Limit: 60 requests per minute per key, shared with MCP endpoint.

data.current_description: A Model Context Protocol server over Streamable HTTP. Each request carries one JSON-RPC 2.0 message: `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call` or `ping`. The tool list is what Cedric offers this caller, and it grows as the workspace connects apps, so it is discovered with `tools/list` and not listed here. Call the `getting_started` tool first; `ask_cedric` hands him a whole task. Takes an API key or a sign-in token. Limits: 60 requests per minute per key, shared with file uploads, and a body of up to 200,000 characters.
data.summary_suggestion: Send a JSON-RPC message to access Cedric's tools
data.description_suggestion: Implements a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over HTTP for accessing Cedric's tools via JSON-RPC 2.0 messages. Supports four message types: `initialize` (establish connection), `tools/list` (discover available tools), `tools/call` (execute a tool), and `ping` (check availability). Available tools grow dynamically as the workspace connects apps and are discovered via `tools/list`. Start with the `getting_started` tool for guidance; use `ask_cedric` to delegate complex tasks. Requires API key or sign-in token. Limits: 60 requests per minute per key (shared with file uploads), request body up to 200,000 characters.
